blocks.html: Robinsons Malls remains true to its commitment to strengthen the fight against COVID-19 as it continues to host more vaccination venues in the Philippine’s major regions. Since March, Robinsons Malls has made its shopping malls readily available to the LGUs as vaccination hubs- reaching out and servicing the growing number of Filipinos from all walks of life across the nation. Robinsons Malls’ presence in strategic locations and key urban cities has been instrumental and is a significant factor for the LGUs to effectively roll out its vaccination drives, encompassing a large number of the Filipino population and encouraging them to be inoculated.

Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Land Corporation’s (RLC) premier mall, is a major participant of Quezon City’s efforts to inoculate over 3,000 residents through the LGU’s EZCONSULT, an application where its residents under A1 –A3 category can register and schedule for their vaccination. Aside from Robinsons Galleria, two other RLC Quezon City-based malls are official vaccination venues: Robinsons Novaliches and Robinsons Magnolia – which is already on its second leg of vaccine roll-out for Brgy. Kaunlaran and Horseshoe Village residents.

To date, there are seventeen (17) Robinsons Malls that have partnered with the LGUs and continue to serve as vaccination hubs: Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Novaliches, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Antipolo and Robinsons Place Imus in Luzon; Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons Place Bacolod, and Robinsons Place Ormoc in Visayas; and Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Place Tagum and Robinsons Cagayan de Oro in Mindanao. Designated areas inside the malls have been inspected by both LGU and City Health Offices and are compliant to their standards. Notable among these is Robinsons Place Imus, where local residents are inoculated through a drive thru system. Robinsons Malls will soon be announcing more vaccination sites in key cities all over the country.
